source: Recovered verbatim from the clinician interface and server validation used during rating.

unit_of_rating.rationale: One generated rationale (target diagnosis or ICD code plus its justification text).
unit_of_rating.pair: Two rationales for the same admission and stage, shown side by side as Response A and Response B.

display.layout: Admission note on the left; V2 pair panel above V4 pair panel on the right.
display.per_response: Target (V4: ICD code followed by its ICD-10-CM description), then the rationale text, then Q1 and Q2.
display.v4_description_note: When a full code has no catalog description, the closest valid parent category is shown with the note '... no exact full-code description listed.'

derived_measures.formula: valid if Q1 == 'Yes' and Q2 == 'Yes'; otherwise not_valid (No and Unclear both count as not valid)
derived_measures.missing: missing if Q1 or Q2 is missing
derived_measures.origin: Primary outcome of the original analysis (merlin_ddx/rebuttal_analysis.py).

missing_uncertain_not_applicable.missing: No answer saved; the original analysis refuses to run with any missing required response.
missing_uncertain_not_applicable.uncertain: Unclear is a valid response category, never imputed.
missing_uncertain_not_applicable.not_applicable: Target preference for pairs with identical targets.
missing_uncertain_not_applicable.legacy_overall_preference: An earlier interface field (preference_A_B_equivalent) is accepted for loading only and never substituted for rationale_preference.

aggregation_rules: Ratings are never averaged across categories; per-item distributions keep every original category.
Q1/Q2 Yes-rates and composite validity rates pool both raters' judgments (denominator = raters x rationales).
Loop minus zero-shot differences use the same admissions in both arms (paired within admission).
Preference shares: loop-preferred, zero-shot-preferred and equal/equivalent counts over all judgments.
In the credentialed per-item aggregates, mean_rating is reported only for valid_composite (share of raters judging the rationale valid).
